Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D game sprite construction kit for Star Swell Coast, NOT a scene. Draw completely new original native art.
Style: strong graphic angular cartoon, very thick crisp near-black navy outer contours, thinner simple internal details, large flat base colors with only 2 or 3 hard-edged cel tones per material. All contours constructed from long straight segments, sharp directional corners, wedges and trapezoids. Square top-view ground with short front face, orthographic, NOT isometric diamond. Warm driftwood brown, sand cream, slate/navy shadows, vivid teal details, restrained coral-orange accents. Transparent background with actual alpha. No texture, grain, glossy rendering, gradients, airbrush, painterly shading, 3D rendering, round buttons, tiny circles, lettering, logos, people, sky, scenery.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 transparent sprite kit sheet, four separated components with generous clear gaps. Component A in upper left: a VERY LONG perfectly horizontal straight carrier strip spanning x30..1240,y110..340, no terminal posts and no perspective convergence, parallel upper/lower edges. Component B on the far right x1330..1500,y20..1000: an equally long straight VERTICAL carrier seen in the SAME overhead plane, continuous parallel side edges, no terminal posts; do not draw a tall upright object as this vertical route. Component C at lower left x70..380,y420..980: one full upright faceted junction/end post with a narrow ground base, complementary to strips. Component D at lower middle x700..1010,y620..960: small four-way square ground connector block. Leave other regions transparent. Components MUST NOT TOUCH. Front view height of the horizontal strip is compact, not a tall wall. All imagery fully inside canvas.
Subject: low harbor rope fence kit. H and V carriers are thick cream/tan braided mooring rope between posts, shown as TWO sturdy clean parallel rope runs secured by angular leather bands at intervals; piecewise straight ropes with clear chamfered directional bends, no loose round loops or winding coils. A few angular kinked sags allowed but long perfectly straight routes. Native H carrier looks like a broad cream zigzag-edged rope strap with dark outline; V carrier has same rope width and braid translated into overhead vertical route. C is chunky square driftwood post with CORAL painted upper band, cream rope tied using straight diagonal segments, faceted dark slate foot. D is compact angular wood/rope square connector. No circular cross-sections.
